title: Database Administrator Roadmap
summary: Build SQL and relational-database depth first, then add Linux, backup/recovery, performance tuning, security, automation and cloud database operations.

facts.Timeline assumption: Four-year B.Tech/B.E. beginning in 2026 and ending around 2030. The milestones below can be shifted to match your university calendar.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: SQL, relational databases, Linux, scripting, database design, backup/recovery and an internship or production-style database project.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: PostgreSQL/MySQL/Oracle/SQL Server expertise, performance tuning, HA/DR, security and cloud databases.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Database architecture, distributed databases, automation, reliability, capacity planning and data-platform ownership.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Cloud-native data platforms, distributed systems, database reliability, security, AI/data workloads and technical leadership.

rows.text: Programming, Linux basics, Git and computer architecture
Linux VM + Git repo + 3 Python/SQL utilities
Relational modelling, SQL, keys, constraints and normalization
Design a normalized database with 10+ related tables and 30+ SQL queries
PostgreSQL administration, indexes, transactions and concurrency
Database lab with indexes, EXPLAIN analysis and transaction experiments
Backup/restore, replication, permissions and Linux database operations
Perform a backup, restore it to a clean instance and document the recovery procedure
Identify and fix 5+ deliberately introduced slow queries; automate recurring DBA tasks
Internship project or accepted contribution + operational runbook
Cloud databases, HA/DR and infrastructure as code
AWS Skill Builder · Microsoft Learn · Terraform
Deploy a cloud database with backup, monitoring, access controls and Terraform
3 database case studies + recovery runbook + performance report + 5 mock interviews

blocks.text: Four-year honours variant

If you choose the four-year honours/research variant, use the additional year for distributed databases, database internals, cloud data platforms, advanced security, research or a substantial industry project.
Specialisation

rows.text: AWS/Azure databases, networking, IAM, monitoring, automation
IAM, encryption, auditing, access control, compliance
Database Security Engineer / Data Security Architect

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move beyond manually operating individual database servers. Learn automation, managed cloud databases, distributed systems, observability, security and data-platform architecture. The long-term value is in reliability and technical decision-making, not just database commands.

blocks.label: Career progression

blocks.text: These are typical stages, not guaranteed promotion dates.
PhD routes

The role should increasingly involve architecture, reliability and data-platform decisions rather than routine manual administration. Cloud-managed databases, distributed systems, automation, security and AI/data workloads will make it important to understand both database internals and the infrastructure around them.
